parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.20.1.2/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family inet address 10.10.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.command: set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 1.1.1.1/32
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet ad.explanation: 配置环回接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set firewall family inet filter ac term.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] from dscp [parameter3]
set firewall family inet filter ac term.command: set firewall family inet filter ac term dd from dscp af11
set firewall family inet filter ac term.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器中的条件，基于DSCP值匹配流量。

set firewall family inet filter ac term.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] then forwarding-class [parameter3]
set firewall family inet filter ac term.command: set firewall family inet filter ac term dd then forwarding-class assured-forwarding
set firewall family inet filter ac term.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器中的动作，将匹配的流量分配到指定的转发类。

set firewall family inet filter ac term.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] then accept
set firewall family inet filter ac term.command: set firewall family inet filter ac term dd then accept
set firewall family inet filter ac term.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器中的动作，接受匹配的流量。

set firewall family inet filter ac term.template: set firewall family inet filter [parameter1] term [parameter2] then accept
set firewall family inet filter ac term.command: set firewall family inet filter ac term else then accept
set firewall family inet filter ac term.explanation: 配置防火墙过滤器中的动作，接受不匹配任何其他条件的流量。

set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet filter input [parameter3]
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family inet filter input ac
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family in.explanation: 在接口上应用输入方向的防火墙过滤器。

set routing-options static route 2.2.2.2.explanation: 配置静态路由，指定目的网络和下一跳地址。

set routing-options static route 10.10.1.command: set routing-options static route 10.10.1.0/24 next-hop ge-0/0/1.0
set routing-options static route 10.10.1.explanation: 配置静态路由，指定目的网络和下一跳接口。

set routing-options static route 10.20.1.command: set routing-options static route 10.20.1.0/24 next-hop ge-0/0/0.0
set routing-options static route 10.20.1.explanation: 配置静态路由，指定目的网络和下一跳接口。

set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.template: set protocols ospf area [parameter1] interface [parameter2] passive
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.command: set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface lo0.0 passive
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.explanation: 配置OSPF区域中的被动接口。

set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.command: set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface ge-0/0/0.0
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface ge-0/0/1.0
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.explanation: 配置OSPF协议的区域和接口。

set routing-options autonomous-system 10.explanation: 配置路由选项中的自治系统号。

set protocols bgp group EBGP-2.2.2.2 typ.command: set protocols bgp group EBGP-2.2.2.2 type external

set protocols bgp group EBGP-2.2.2.2 loc.command: set protocols bgp group EBGP-2.2.2.2 local-address 1.1.1.1

set protocols bgp group EBGP-2.2.2.2 pee.command: set protocols bgp group EBGP-2.2.2.2 peer-as 200
set protocols bgp group EBGP-2.2.2.2 pee.explanation: 配置BGP组的对等自治系统号。

set protocols bgp group EBGP-2.2.2.2 nei.command: set protocols bgp group EBGP-2.2.2.2 neighbor 2.2.2.2

set protocols bgp group EBGP-2.2.2.2 mul.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] multihop ttl [parameter2]
set protocols bgp group EBGP-2.2.2.2 mul.command: set protocols bgp group EBGP-2.2.2.2 multihop ttl 2

set protocols bgp group EBGP-2.2.2.2 fam.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] family inet unicast redistribute connected
set protocols bgp group EBGP-2.2.2.2 fam.command: set protocols bgp group EBGP-2.2.2.2 family inet unicast redistribute connected
set protocols bgp group EBGP-2.2.2.2 fam.explanation: 配置BGP组的地址族和重分发直连路由。

set protocols bgp group IBGP-10.20.1.1 t.command: set protocols bgp group IBGP-10.20.1.1 type internal

set protocols bgp group IBGP-10.20.1.1 l.command: set protocols bgp group IBGP-10.20.1.1 local-address 1.1.1.1

set protocols bgp group IBGP-10.20.1.1 p.command: set protocols bgp group IBGP-10.20.1.1 peer-as 100
set protocols bgp group IBGP-10.20.1.1 p.explanation: 配置BGP组的对等自治系统号。

set protocols bgp group IBGP-10.20.1.1 n.command: set protocols bgp group IBGP-10.20.1.1 neighbor 10.20.1.1

set policy-options community c_10_10 mem.explanation: 配置策略选项中的社区成员。

set policy-options policy-statement aa t.template: set policy-options policy-statement [parameter1] term [parameter2] from community [parameter3]
set policy-options policy-statement aa t.command: set policy-options policy-statement aa term t1 from community c_10_10
set policy-options policy-statement aa t.explanation: 配置策略选项中的策略声明术语的来源社区。

set policy-options policy-statement aa t.command: set policy-options policy-statement aa term t1 then accept
set policy-options policy-statement aa t.explanation: 配置策略选项中的策略声明术语的动作。

set policy-options policy-statement aa t.command: set policy-options policy-statement aa term default then reject
set policy-options policy-statement aa t.explanation: 配置策略语句中的默认项为拒绝。

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: 策略项的名称，default表示默认项。

set protocols bgp group EBGP-2.2.2.2 imp.command: set protocols bgp group EBGP-2.2.2.2 import aa
